added.name: Kailash Labs
added.long_description:
The world generates petabytes of video every day, and almost none of it is readable to machines.  Frontier VLMs that can unlock this (like Gemini) are too expensive to run at the volume real industries have, too generic for any single task, and can't be deployed on-prem where sensitive video lives.

We are building an auto vision factory: take video plus a customer's objective, distill a frontier model, and post-train a small open model that is SOTA on that one task and serve it blazingly fast. Our first product, Marlin, is a 2B-parameter open-weights video VLM that matches Gemini-2.5-flash on dense captioning and temporal grounding at a fraction of the cost.
added.one_liner: A factory for small and specialized video reasoning models

added.name: Agent Relay
added.long_description: Agent Relay helps software teams work better with coding agents, and helps those agents work better as a team. It gives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and custom agents shared messaging, session history, and access to tools like GitHub, Linear, and Slack. Teams can see what every agent is doing, run checked and resumable workflows, and step in when human judgment is needed. Run it in our cloud, locally, or on your own hardware.
added.one_liner: The infrastructure to run coding agents for your team

added.name: Invertix
added.long_description:
The next constraint is not intelligence, it is the energy cost of running it.
We deploy custom AI models inside energy companies that ingest SCADA data, work orders, and grid topology,  operational data no public model has seen, grounded in physics-informed neural networks and differentiable grid simulators. 
This creates a flywheel: more operator data → better process understanding → more efficient operations → cheaper energy → cheaper AI → more deployment → more data. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uDH6pMn5OE

AI compute doubles every 2.2 years. Data center demand grows from 415 to 945 TWh by 2030. Without near-zero energy cost, AI remains limited by human infrastructure. We are the layer that runs AI at zero energy cost.
Energy is a $10 trillion market. The infrastructure layer doesn't exist yet. 
We are building it.
added.one_liner: Energy Superintelligence, AI that runs energy operations.

added.name: Streamline Systems
added.long_description:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. We're currently working with commercial and military end users to deploy the capability.
added.one_liner: Precision navigation for UAVs operating without GPS.

added.name: Volaren Inc.
added.long_description:
Every great investment starts as an idea about the world. Institutions have teams of analysts turning those ideas into positions. Volaren is that team, processing data through fundamentals and quantitative models that can be personalized with AI.

Turn your views into trades, portfolios, and strategies, or co-invest alongside top traders and hedge funds. Volaren stays with you from there, showing you what's actually driving each position and what it means for your next move.
added.one_liner: Democratizing investing. Volaren collapses the hedge fund model and…

long_description.before: Heron analyzes 60,000+ small businesses a day to make sure good deals reach your underwriters in minutes, and bad deals never do. We power underwriting across small business finance and insurance: MCA, term loans, SBA, and commercial insurance
long_description.after: Heron is on a mission to eliminate the underwriting tax on American businesses. When a consumer applies for credit, a spinning wheel can return an offer in seconds; when a business applies for a loan or insurance policy, humans still spend hours reading documents, verifying the business, detecting fraud, and deciding what to offer. Heron does that work in software: lenders, insurers, and credit brokers send applications in and get declines and offers out in minutes instead of days. We have underwritten roughly 1 in 8 US employer businesses in the past year. That scale allows us to go beyond what any individual could ever do: identify cross-customer signals across millions of businesses to build new data products, and ultimately become the data layer for private businesses in the US. Backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator.

one_liner.after: Underwriting automation for small business finance

long_description.before:
Lingo.dev is the localization engineering platform: the best way to measure translation quality, translate with LLMs, and proofread with native speakers.

Lingo.dev is built for teams accountable for quality in languages they can't read. Teams configure localization engines, stateful translation APIs that hold the glossary, brand voice, and per-locale model preferences, and every request retrieves that context at inference time through retrieval augmented localization. Every translation is scored before it goes live, scores and corrections tune the engine, and the localization team runs the localization infrastructure. Integrate through the API, CLI, CI/CD, or native integrations with the code repository and the CMS. 

Lingo.dev is the standard localization infrastructure for modern enterprise teams scaling into new markets – including Mistral, Solana, SoSafe, and Cal.com. Over 300M words processed, SOC 2 Type II compliant.

long_description.before:
Zavo is the AI-powered operating system for restaurants.

We bring payments, point of sale, and AI agents into one unified platform, so restaurants can run their entire business seamlessly.

From reservations to payments to POS, Zavo replaces fragmented tools with a fully integrated stack built in-house. Our AI agents automate repetitive tasks, streamline operations, and help teams focus on delivering great guest experiences.
long_description.after:
Zavo is a data company building proprietary, real-world data infrastructure for frontier AI. We partner with hospitals, businesses, operators and expert networks globally to access hard-to-reach data that cannot be found on the public internet.

We source, structure, annotate and license this data for model training, post-training and evaluation, and use it to build specialised benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments grounded in real-world workflows, expert decisions and outcomes.

Our focus spans healthcare and robotics, where high-quality proprietary data, realistic environments and reliable evaluations are critical to building increasingly capable AI systems.

one_liner.after: Unlocking the world’s most valuable data for frontier AI.

long_description.before:
Bravi is building the AI operating system for home-services businesses, using AI-powered customer communication as the wedge.

We replace the front office (calls, chats, follow-ups) with AI agents that never miss a lead, then layer an internal AI copilot that understands products, pricing, and technical documentation.

We started with fenestration (shutters, windows, garage doors), a large, complex vertical with no modern software, before expanding to adjacent trades.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.

long_description.before:
Avoice is an AI-native workspace for architecture firms that automates the non-design work that takes time away from design. The platform uses AI agents that understand drawings, specifications, schedules, materials, codes, and research. Today, firms using Avoice manage over $300M in active projects on the platform.

Architecture is a massive market ($300B+) but a deeply underserved one: highly fragmented, dominated by small firms, and reliant on legacy tools that require heavy customization. AI creates a unique opportunity to deliver firm-specific automation at scale, and Avoice brings these workflows into become the operating system for architectural practice.
long_description.after:
Avoice is an all-in-one, AI-native platform for running an architecture practice. It covers the whole arc of a project: pricing and proposals to win the work, research and schedules in early design, specifications and QA/QC checks through documentation, contract particulars and preliminaries at tender, then RFIs, submittals, instructions, certificates and valuations through construction, and the compliance record at handover. Timesheets, fees, financials and invoicing run alongside, with Xero and QuickBooks.

Specification is the most-used part of the platform. Avoice drafts coordinated, tender-ready specifications from a practice's own drawings, schedules and office masters, then checks them back against those drawings. Work that normally takes weeks takes an afternoon.

Practices in the UK, US, Australia and New Zealand use Avoice, from boutique studios to firms of several hundred people. It integrates with Revit and ArchiCAD.
